title: Quanta Services, Inc. Form 10-Q for the quarter ended June 30, 2026
excerpt: At June 30 Quanta had USD 506.4 million cash, USD 6.096 billion total long-term debt obligations, USD 2.26 billion of remaining revolving capacity, and complied with all credit-agreement covenants.
summary: The Q2 Form 10-Q validates current diluted share count, segment margins, backlog composition, acquisition accounting, debt maturities and liquidity. It also shows 68.8% of quarterly revenue used percentage-of-completion accounting and retains contract-estimate, collection, labor, acquisition, leverage and goodwill risks.
